Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Orders are fulfilled by Northwind Logistics, and one cart becomes one order. The contract (docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, section 4) accepts at most 60 lines per order.

40 inquiries from customers who could not add more than 60 items.
Requested cart sizes: median 80, largest 100.
The customers who wrote in buy the same product mix as customers overall.

steps.message: The 60 limit came from the Northwind contract, which ended on 2025-10-31. The config and design doc already say 100, so only ADR 0007 is stale. I'll record a superseding decision.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p docs/decisions && cat > docs/decisions/0008-cart-item-limit-100.md <<'EOF'
# Decision 0008: Cart item limit is 100
Status: Accepted (2026-11-01)
Supersedes: docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md

## Context
ADR 0007 set the limit to 60 because Northwind Logistics accepted at most 60 lines per order (contract section 4). That contract ended on 2025-10-31, and since 2025-11-01 fulfilment is from our own warehouse, which has no line limit (docs/ops/fulfilment.md).
In 2026-08, 40 customers reported being unable to add more than 60 items; requested sizes had a median of 80 and a maximum of 100 (docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md). Commit 26d74db raised the limit to 100 in config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md but left ADR 0007 unchanged, causing the inconsistency in issue #12.

## Decision
A cart holds at most 100 items. config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md already reflect this. ADR 0007 is marked superseded.

## Consequences
The 100 figure is a product choice based on observed demand, not a technical constraint. Any future limit change should be recorded in docs/decisions/.
EOF
sed -i 's/^Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)/Status: Superseded by docs\/decisions\/0008-cart-item-limit-100.md (was Accepted 2024-09-02; the Northwind 60-line constraint no longer applies)/' docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md
git add -A && git commit -qm "docs: record cart limit of 100, supersede ADR 0007

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline -1

steps.message:
I settled the cart limit at 100, so the config and docs now agree, and I committed the change locally (`7ae38df`). I haven't pushed it or commented on issue #12.

**Why 100:**
- **Where the 60 came from:** ADR 0007 set the limit to 60 because the Northwind Logistics contract capped orders at 60 lines.
- **Why it no longer applies:** That contract ended on 2025-10-31. Since 2025-11-01 we fulfil from our own warehouse, which has no line limit.
- **What customers asked for:** 40 customers wrote in about the 60 cap, asking for up to 100 items.
- **Why the repo disagreed:** The earlier commit "raise cart limit to 100" updated `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` but left ADR 0007 saying 60.

**Changes:**
- **New decision record:** `docs/decisions/0008-cart-item-limit-100.md` records the reasoning and says it supersedes ADR 0007.
- **Old ADR:** The status line in `docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md` now reads superseded, pointing to the new record. I left the rest of that ADR as it was.
- **Config and design doc:** Unchanged, since both already said 100.

Existing ADRs live in `docs/adr/`, but you asked for `docs/decisions/`, so I created that directory.
